articles.text: SHĀLĀ PÍĚRSĒN: Èi, Xiǎo Chén, mǎi dōngxi qu le?
SARAH PEARSON: Hey, Xiǎo Chén, have you been out shopping?
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Shì a, lái Guǎngzhōu, bù néng kōngshǒu huíqu, wǒ gěi wǒ àiren mǎile yíjiàn chènshān.
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Yes. When one comes to Guǎngzhōu, one can't go back empty-handed. I bought a shirt for my wife.
SHĀLĀ PÍĚRSĒN: Hé! Hǎo gāojíde chènshān! Jiàqian yě bú cuò. Dāi huǐr wǒ yě qù mǎi liǎngjiàn. Zhèizhǒng chènshān shi Guǎngzhōu shēngchǎnde ma?
SARAH PEARSON: Well! What a classy shirt! The price is also pretty good. Later, I'll go buy a couple, too. Is this kind of shirt produced in Guǎngzhōu?
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Bú shì, shi Sūzhōu shēngchǎnde.
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: No, it's produced in Sūzhōu.
SHĀLĀ PÍĚRSĒN: Wǒmen zài Sūzhōude shíhou méi jiànguo! Kànqilai Zhōngguóde hǎo dōngxi dōu jízhōng dào Guǎngzhōu lái le!
SARAH PEARSON: We didn't see any when we were in Sūzhōu! Apparently, all of China's good things come together in Guǎngzhōu!
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Guǎngjiāohuìshangde jīqì ya, xiāofèipǐn la, dōu shi cóng quánguó yùnláide, zhǎnlǎn yǐhòu jiù zài Guǎngzhōu mài, suǒyǐ zhèr shāngdiànli màide dōngxi yòu duō yòu hǎo.

CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: The machines and consumer items at the Guǎngzhōu Trade Fair are shipped here from all over the country, and after being exhibited, are sold right here in Guǎngzhōu, so the stores here sell a lot of different items, and of good quality.
SHĀLĀ PÍĚRSĒN: Xiǎo Chén, wǒ xiǎng gēn ni dǎting yíxiàr ne, Guǎngzhōu fùjìnde jiāgōng gōngyè xiànzài fāzhǎnde zěnmeyàng le?
SARAH PEARSON: Xiǎo Chén, I wanted to find out from you how the processing industry in the vicinity of Guǎngzhōu is developing?
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Jìn nián lái, fāzhǎnde bù màn. Zhǔyào shi zhèixiē gōngchǎng yǒu wàiguó gōngsī cānjiā, suǒyǐ tāmende shēngchǎn hěn yǒu tèdiǎn.

CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: In recent years, it has been developing rather quickly. The main thing is that there are some foreign companies participating in these factories, so their production is very distinctive.
SHĀLĀ PÍĚRSĒN: Wǒ jīntian zài bàozhǐshang kàndào yíge xiāoxi, shuō zài jǐge dìfang chénglìle "jīngjì tèqū."
SARAH PEARSON: I saw a story in the paper today that said that "special economic zones" have been established in several places.
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Shì. Zài Guǎngdōng, Fújiàn, Shànghǎi, dōu yǐjīng yǒu zhèiyangde tèqū. Yǐhòu dàgài hái huì gèng duō.
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Yes. There are already special zones like this in Guǎngdōng, Fújiàn, and Shànghǎi. In the future, there will probably be even more of them.
SHĀLĀ PÍĚRSĒN: Yǒu méiyou tèbiéde fǎlǜ guǎn zhèixiē dìqūde jīngjì qíngkuàng?
SARAH PEARSON: Are there special laws governing the situations in these special economic zones?
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Yǒu. Wǒmen yǒu Zhōngwénde, yě yǒu Yīngwénde, nǐ xūyào ma?
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Yes. We have the Chinese and the English versions. Do you need it?
SHĀLĀ PÍĚRSĒN: Xūyào a!
SARAH PEARSON: Yes!
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Ō, duì le, nǐ shi lǜshī a! Dāngrán xūyào le. Wǒ mǎshàng jiù qù zhǎo. Nǐ yào Zhōngwénde háishi Yīngwénde?
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Oh, right: you're a lawyer! Of course you need it. I'll go get it right away. Do you want the Chinese or the English?
SHĀLĀ PÍĚRSĒN: Wǒ dōu yào.
SARAH PEARSON: Both.
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Hǎo, Lǚxíngshè, fàndiànli dōu yǒu, dāi yíxiàr huíqu wǒ gěi nǐ ná. Duì le, kěnéng jiāoyìhuìlǐ yě yǒu, wǒ qù gěi ni wènwen.
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Okay. The Travel Service and the hotel both have it. Later, when we go back, I'll get it for you. Oh, right--maybe they also have it at the trade fair. I'll go ask them for you.
SHĀLĀ PÍĚRSĒN: Hǎo ba! Wǒmen yìqǐ qù, yìbiān zǒu yìbiān liáoliao.
SARAH PEARSON: All right! Let's go together, and chat on the way.
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Hǎo!
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Okay!

CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Nǐ dàgài tīngshuō le, xiànzài jìnchūkǒude xiànzhì bǐjiào shǎo le, wǒmen yòu hé xǔduō guójiā dìngle màoyì tiáoyuē, kāishǐ gǎo jīngjì hézuò. Suǒyǐ zuìjìn zhèixiē niánde jiāoyìhuì tèbié rènao.

CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: You've probably heard that now there are fewer restrictions on imports and exports, and we have also concluded trade treaties with many countries, and are starting to engage in economic cooperation. So the trade fair has been particularly lively the past few years.

SHĀLĀ PÍĚRSĒN: Zhèi yìdiǎn wǒ yě zhùyìdào le, xiànzài yì zǒujìn jiāoyìhuì dàtīng, yǎnjing jiù bú gòu yòng le, zhēn shi yuè bàn yuè hǎo le, wǒ hái tīngshuō xiànzài biéde dìfang yě yǒu xiǎo guīmóde jiāoyìhuì le, hěn duō wàiguó dàibiǎotuán qù cānjiā, shì ma?

SARAH PEARSON: I've noticed that myself. Now, as soon as you walk into the hall of the trade fair, your eyes can't take everything in. It's really getting better and better. And I hear that now there are small-scale trade fairs in other places, which a lot of foreign delegations attend. Is that so?

CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Shì. Tèbié shi yǒule Zhōng-Měi hǎiyùn tiáoyuē yǐhòu, jǐge dà hǎigǎng gèng fánróng le. Zài zhèixiē hǎigǎng, hái yǒu Běijīng, xiànzài dōu yǒu xiǎo guīmóde jiāoyìhuì, yǒu xǔduō wàiguó shāngren zài nàr zuò mǎimai.

CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Yes. Especially since the Sino-American sea transportation treaty, the larger ports have become even more prosperous. In these ports and in Běijīng, there are now small-scale trade fairs where many foreign merchants do business.
SHĀLĀ PÍĚRSĒN: Duì, duì, duì. Wǒ tīngshuō le. Suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng yǐhòu yánhǎi yídài huì yǒu hěn dàde fāzhǎn.
SARAH PEARSON: Oh, yes. I've heard that. So I think the coastal region will develop greatly in the future.
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Wǒ yě zènme xiǎng.
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: I think so, too.
SHĀLĀ PÍĚRSĒN: Wǒ hái yǒu yíge wèntí, zài jīngjì tèqūli gōngzuòde gōngren, gōngzī shì bu shì gāo yìdiǎnr ne?
SARAH PEARSON: I have another question: Do the workers in special economic zones have higher wages?
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Wǒ xiǎng gāo yìdiǎnr.
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: I believe so.
SHĀLĀ PÍĚRSĒN: Nà bú shi huì chūxiàn yíge xīnde jiējí ma?
SARAH PEARSON: Then might not a new class arise?
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Méi nàme yánzhòng!
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: It's not that serious!
SHĀLĀ PÍĚRSĒN: Wèishénme?
SARAH PEARSON: Why?
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Yìbānde lái shuō, yǒu wàiguó gōngsī cānjiāde gōngchǎng, suīrán gōngzī gāo yìdiǎnr, kěshi gōngzuò xiàolǜ yě bǐjiào gāo a. "Duō láo duō dé" shi shèhuìzhǔyìde jīngjì zhèngcè ma!

CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Generally speaking, in factories that have the participation of foreign companies, although the wages are higher, the efficiency is also higher. "More pay for more work" is the economic policy of socialism, you see!
SHĀLĀ PÍĚRSĒN: "Duō láo duō dé"! Zhèige zhèngcè bú cuò.
SARAH PEARSON: "More pay for more work"! That's a good policy.
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Ō, duì le, nǐ bié wàngle, jīntian wǎnshang wǒmen zài fàndiànli yǒu yíge wǎnhuì.
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Oh, right--don't forget that we have a party in the restaurant tonight.
SHĀLĀ PÍĚRSĒN: Wǎnhuì? Duìbuqǐ, wǒ bú jìde le.
SARAH PEARSON: Party? Excuse me, but I don't remember.
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Zuótian gěi nǐ sòngqùde qǐngtiě. Nǐ wàng le?
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: The invitation was sent over to you yesterday. Have you forgotten?
SHĀLĀ PÍĚRSĒN: Ō, duì le, shi huānsònghuì!
SARAH PEARSON: Oh, yes: it's a farewell party!
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Shì, shi Zhōngguó Lǚxíngshè bànde. Shi huānsòng, yě shi huānyíng.
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Yes. It's being given by the China Travel Service. It's to send you off, but also to welcome you.
SHĀLĀ PÍĚRSĒN: Huānyíng?
SARAH PEARSON: Welcome?
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Huānyíng nǐmen zài lái ya!
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: To welcome you to come again!
SHĀLĀ PÍĚRSĒN: Dāngrán, wǒmen yídìng huì zài lái.
SARAH PEARSON: Of course. We'll be sure to come again.
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: Nǐ qiānwàn bié wàngle. Wǎnshang qīdiǎn bàn!
CHÉN GUÓQIÁNG: You mustn't forget. Seven-thirty in the evening!
SHĀLĀ PÍĚRSĒN: Hǎo, wǒ yídìng lái!
SARAH PEARSON: Okay, I'll be sure to come!
